subject: planner: Update default for index selectivity ratio (#61097)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: the only in-scope code change is `pkg/sessionctx/vardef/tidb_vars.go` updating `DefTiDBOptOrderingIdxSelRatio` from `-1` (disabled) to `0.01` (enabled by default). Verified consumption path in planner (`pkg/planner/cardinality/cross_estimation.go:AdjustRowCountForIndexScanByLimit` called from `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go`) only affects cardinality/cost estimation for ORDER BY/keep-order index scans under LIMIT; it does not alter SQL semantics, transaction/session correctness, privilege/visibility, or protocol/runtime behavior. Sysvar remains a float in range [-1,1] (`pkg/sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go`) and session-var semantics are consistent (`pkg/sessionctx/variable/session.go`). No Blocker/High issues found.
